style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight
subject: ONE potto, shaggy golden brown fur, huge round eyes, short tail, strong gripping hands, dressed rich like a croupier: a black velvet waistcoat with gold buttons, a red silk bow tie, gold rings
second_characters: two tree frogs, his table hands, huge at the lens; a row of flamingo showgirls in ruffles dancing cancan on a low stage one pace behind him, legs kicked high

props.tokens: blank round tokens, heaped on the table
props.coin: ONE gold coin with a bitcoin sign, held to the end
props.rake: ONE wooden rake, dragged at him

environment: an open air betting floor in a jungle clearing at noon, the lit stage and a wall of leaves and tables filling the frame to its top edge, pollen flying
lighting: flat white daylight through the canopy, cyan edge left, warm amber fill right
motion_rule: the world flies INTO the hero: the frogs hurl tokens and leaves at the glass every beat and he beats them off. He throws his body the full frame width ALWAYS SIDEWAYS, muzzle to the lens, both hands working. The rake only slides at him. The camera circles him and never stops, new shot size every beat, medium to close. ONE hero action per beat, the stage kicking behind him.

audio.rate: 3.5 syllables per second, each line fits its beat
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, speech ends by 5.55, then tokens and heels carry it
audio.lip_sync: jaw opens on every syllable, mouth empty while speaking
audio.pronunciation: KRIP-ta, ka-zi-NO, vy-I-gra-yesh, vsyeg-DA, TOL-ko, ty

timeline.a: hurls both arms through a heap of tokens and they burst into the lens, gold buttons flashing; the showgirls kick high behind him
throws his body the full frame width along the table, batting tokens off the glass; a frog shoves the rake at him
rakes a heap to his chest on the swing, muzzle to the lens; the showgirls shake their ruffles over his shoulder
whips the full width the other way as the heap is dragged out of his arms; tokens shoot across the lens
throws both arms up and the frogs pour tokens over him at the glass; the whole stage kicks high behind him
both frogs drag the pile away from the lens and he swings his whole body after it, arms full width
a frog presses the gold coin into his palm across the lens and his fist closes on it
he drives that coin at the lens, fist filling the frame, throwing his body the full width behind it
he beats a wave of tokens off the glass with his free arm, the showgirls kicking behind him
he whips the full width the other way across the cleared table and shoves the rake past the lens
he slams his free hand down and tokens shoot at the glass; a frog tumbles over the lens
he drives the coin and his muzzle into the lens together, fist and face filling the frame

must_appear: at 6.15 a frog presses the gold bitcoin coin into his palm; he holds it to the end; at 9.20 he drives it and his muzzle into the lens, fist filling the frame; the showgirls kick cancan behind him the whole clip; the waistcoat and bow tie on him every beat
negative_prompt: printed words, digits, Cyrillic, subtitles, watermark, speech bubble, black bars, a horizontal 16:9 frame, night, studio lighting, a bare hero, a prop worked in place, hero riding a belt or cart, a hero held in one pose, parked camera, push in, motionless or empty background, wide shot, view from behind, a motionless first or last second, a beat without the hero, speech after 5.55, offscreen narration, English speech, a second potto
